description: This is a Java source file defining the CreateGestureActivity class, which allows users to create gestures within an Android application. It handles gesture input, saving, and cancellation, and manages gesture state during activity lifecycle events.

classes.name: CreateGestureActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for creating gestures, handling gesture input, saving, and restoring state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and attaches gesture listener.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current gesture in the activity state bundle.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the gesture from saved instance state and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: addGesture
methods.description: Handles the event of adding a gesture, saving it to the gesture library if valid.

methods.name: cancelGesture
methods.description: Cancels gesture creation and finishes the activity.
